hero.description: Plan your week, log every set and rep, and track your progress. The fitness app that adapts to you.

features.subtitle: Features designed so you can focus on what matters: your training.

weeklyPlan.title: Weekly Plan
weeklyPlan.description: Organize your weekly workouts with a calendar view. Mark your check-ins and keep your streak going.

exerciseLog.title: Exercise Log
exerciseLog.description: Log sets, reps and weight for every exercise. Visualize the muscles you're working.

reusableRoutines.title: Reusable Routines
reusableRoutines.description: Create and save your favorite routines. Start them with one tap whenever you want to repeat them.

progressTracking.title: Progress Tracking
progressTracking.description: See your training history, streak and stats. All in your profile.

customizable.title: Customizable
customizable.description: Set your goal, level, equipment and training days to fit you.

timer.title: Built-in Timer
timer.description: Rest timer between sets to keep your session's intensity up.

cta.description: Download the app and take your training to the next level. Free.
